name: Color Converter
description: Convert colors between HEX, RGB and HSL in your browser.

name: Cron Expression Lab
description: Explain, build and schedule cron expressions in your browser. Get a plain-language description, a per-field breakdown, and the next run times in any time zone with daylight-saving handled. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Content Security Policy Builder
description: Build, validate, explain and export Content Security Policy headers in your browser. Score a policy, catch unsafe directives and copy it as a header, meta tag or server config. Nothing is uploaded.

name: CSV to JSON
description: Convert CSV into clean JSON, locally in your browser.

name: Dataset Profiler
description: Profile CSV, TSV or JSON datasets in your browser: column types, missing values, distributions, outliers, duplicates and correlations. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Design Token Studio
description: Parse, normalize, inspect and convert design tokens between DTCG JSON, CSS variables, SCSS, Less, Tailwind, Swift and Android. Resolve aliases, catch broken or circular references and check WCAG contrast — all locally in your browser.

name: File Checksum
description: Compute SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and MD5 checksums for any file, right in your browser.

name: File Integrity Auditor
description: Verify a set of files against a checksum manifest and see what matches, what changed and what is missing. Hashing and comparison run locally in your browser.

name: Image Lab
description: Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, blur and sharpen on your images locally in the browser.

name: JSON Formatter
description: Format, validate and inspect JSON in your browser.

name: JWT Inspector
description: Decode, analyse, verify and create JSON Web Tokens in your browser. Inspect the header and claims, check expiry, review security issues, and verify or produce HMAC, RSA, ECDSA and EdDSA signatures. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Log Analyzer
description: Analyze server, application and structured logs in your browser. Get severity counts, a throughput timeline, grouped messages, top errors and exception types, and search a large log in a virtualized view. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Markdown Workspace
description: Write Markdown with a live, safely-rendered preview, an outline you can jump through, document statistics and a health check for common mistakes. Everything runs locally in your browser.

name: OpenAPI Request Builder
description: Load an OpenAPI 3 or Swagger 2 document, pick an operation, fill in the parameters and get a runnable request with curl, fetch, Node, Python and raw HTTP snippets. Runs entirely in your browser.

name: Regex Tester
description: Test JavaScript regular expressions against your own text, with live match stats and a split view. Runs entirely in your browser.

name: Subnet Calculator
description: Calculate IPv4 network and broadcast addresses, netmasks, host ranges and reverse DNS, split subnets by prefix or host count, merge CIDR lists and check address membership. Runs entirely in your browser.

name: Text Case Lab
description: Convert text and identifiers between camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, Title Case and more, detect the current style, and run cleanup transforms on whitespace, accents and curly punctuation. Everything runs locally in your browser.

name: Text Diff
description: Compare two texts and see additions and removals highlighted clearly.

name: UUID Generator
description: Generate UUID v4 values, one or many at a time, in your browser.

name: Webhook Signature Lab
description: Generate and verify HMAC webhook signatures for GitHub, Stripe, Slack, Shopify, Standard Webhooks and custom services. See the exact signed payload, check a received header and copy a verification recipe — all locally in your browser.
